- **Scope:** Includes only thermal assets >30 MWe as requested. Focuses on major coal, domestic gas, and imported LNG facilities that shape Vietnam's baseload and mid-merit dispatch.
- **Status & COD:** Reflects official PDP8 (May 2023) classifications and publicly reported commissioning timelines. Post-2024 delays, financing changes, or policy revisions are not captured.
- **Technology Classification:** Coal plants are categorized by steam cycle design (Subcritical/Supercritical/USC) per MOIT technical annexes. Gas/LNG plants are classified as CCGT (combined cycle) or OCGT (open cycle) per EPC specifications.
- **Source Formatting:** Per explicit system constraints, I cannot perform web searches, invoke tools, or fabricate URLs. Sources are cited by official document title, issuing authority, and section reference. Live URLs can be located on the official MOIT, EVN, PVN, or Vietnamese Government portals using the document titles provided.
- **Completeness:** Vietnam's thermal fleet exceeds 40 units >30 MWe. This table provides a structured, primary-source-aligned cross-section covering all fuel types, technologies, and status categories. A full national registry requires direct extraction from MOIT's PDP8 implementation database and provincial DOE licensing records.
